mentions.name: FocusedFeed
mentions.description: This iOS app organizes YouTube subscriptions into custom categories so users can view specific channel groups (e.g. tech or cooking channels) without algorithmic noise. It signs in with Google to pull subscriptions, automatically filters out Shorts, and offers a web app version; AI-generated weekly newsletter digests summarizing favorite channels' posts are in development.
mentions.problem: YouTube's home feed becomes useless once you're subscribed to 200+ channels, filled with Shorts and algorithm-recommended content, making it hard to find the creators you actually care about.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building FocusedFeed (https://focusedfeed.app) an iOS app that lets you organize your YouTube subscriptions into categories and actually find the creators you care about.
